recommendation: Keep this source change. It implements the applied resolution at the build-scoped operation definition without duplicating the SubscriptionStatus requirements. The separate Jira comment about versioned references was not part of the final applied resolution and should not be expanded without a new work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-47292 is an Applied/Persuasive R6 FHIR-I change request asking whether SubscriptionStatus focus and additionalContext guidance applies to SubscriptionStatus resources returned by the Subscription $status operation. The approved resolution was to add a link from the $status operation to the relevant SubscriptionStatus section, specifically the query-status guidance.
initial_application: No prior FHIR-47292-tagged source commit or combined-branch reconcile commit was found. Current source already had a SubscriptionStatus Query Status section and PR #3967 contained nearby SubscriptionStatus/$status work, including FHIR-47291 on the operation description and a separate subscription-status query linking commit, but the Subscription $status OperationDefinition still described the return Bundle without linking to the SubscriptionStatus query-status guidance.
additional_context: The Subscription and SubscriptionStatus resources are active build inputs in source/fhir.ini, and source/subscription/list-Subscription-operations.xml includes OperationDefinition/Subscription-status. The SubscriptionStatus Query Status section already defines the requirements for query-status SubscriptionStatus resources, while Confluence minutes confirm FHIR-I approved FHIR-47292 in the R6 Subscriptions block vote. A Zulip search found the block-vote announcement and no conflicting implementation discussion.
reconciliation: Added a markdown link in source/subscription/operationdefinition-Subscription-status.xml from the $status return parameter documentation to subscriptionstatus.html#query-status, so readers of the operation page are directed to the applicable SubscriptionStatus guidance for returned resources.
